purpose: Descriptive single-component warmup cutoff comparison; not a new production API
cpu_policy: serial on one pinned allowed CPU after all broad/focused jobs finish
shared_control_change: Both arms reconstruct the same retained leapfrog NUTS with one charged extra target evaluation and no extra RNG draw; compare old control raw draws against prior ablation.
limitations: Changes the cutoff for both search and actual HMC warmup proposals; does not separately attribute search versus warmup-transition contributions. Whole native-NUTS pilot is a separate comparison.
